title: Odin Set

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Odin Set is a DLC armor set only available for the early supporters of Valheim via a Steam code sent out in an email from Iron Gate Studios to those who signed up for the Valheim Beta. It is the same tier as Rag Armor. Both sets are replaced by Leather armor.
The set of armor has two pieces which have repairing and initial crafting level at 1. Hood of Odin has a durability of 300 and Cape of Odin has a durability of 1500. They are crafted and upgraded at the Workbench:
Crafting the full set requires 20 Leather scraps and 8 Coal providing 2 armor total. Crafting the fully upgraded set requires 80 Leather scraps and 32 Coal providing 8 armor total.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • The cape and hood can be spawned via commands, but cannot be equipped without the DLC.

Odin Set

Introduction. The Odin Set is a DLC armor set only available for the early supporters of Valheim via a Steam code sent out in an email from Iron Gate Studios to those who signed up for the Valheim Beta. It is the same tier as Rag Armor. Both sets are replaced by Leather armor.
The set of armor has two pieces which have repairing and initial crafting level at 1. Hood of Odin has a durability of 300 and Cape of Odin has a durability of 1500. They are crafted and upgraded at the Workbench:
Crafting the full set requires 20 Leather scraps and 8 Coal providing 2 armor total. Crafting the fully upgraded set requires 80 Leather scraps and 32 Coal providing 8 armor total.

Notes. • The cape and hood can be spawned via commands, but cannot be equipped without the DLC.
